title: Capture what a person changed in an announcement, and how far it should reach
description:
When a Delivery is sent (or a preferred version is saved) with a person's changes, record on the Delivery, once: the machine draft version, the final version, and the person's choice of scope, asked in one tap when they save: 'just this one', 'this channel', 'this kind on this channel', or 'the whole publication', with an optional one-line reason (stored with the text version in S3). No choice means 'not decided': the edit is kept as a candidate and changes nothing. The difference between the two versions is computed from the stored versions when needed, not stored again.

**Acceptance criteria**
- An edited Delivery records which version was the machine's and which was sent.
- With no scope chosen, nothing about future drafts changes.
- The reason text is not in the catalog row.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- delivery-edit-capture.feature: an edit with scope 'this channel' is recorded as an example for that channel; an edit with no scope is a candidate; an unedited send records nothing; the reason is stored in S3.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Amplify data: short fields on `Delivery` (`exampleScope`, `exampleState`, `machineVersion`); one sparse index for active examples, in its own release.

**Part of:** Announcements learn from a person's edits. Slice code O1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.

comments.author: home
comments.text: lead8: Merged in #1717 (develop, not released). Delivery fields machineVersion, exampleScope, exampleState, exampleAt, exampleKey; announcements_example (person only); candidate/this_one/channel/kind/publication; reason in S3. Spec delivery-edit-capture.feature. The sparse index for active examples shipped with O3 (#1728), which must go in a release of its own.
